'''Aravind Srinivasan''' (born 1968) is a Distinguished University Professor of computer science at the [[University of Maryland, College Park]], with simultaneous appointments in the Department of Computer Science, UMIACS (University of Maryland Institute for Advanced Computer Studies), and AMSC. His research focuses on algorithms particularly randomized and probabilistic methods and their applications in fields ranging from machine learning, data science, health, and algorithmic fairness to networks, cloud computing, and sustainable systems.

==Education and academic career==
Srinivasan earned his B.Tech. from [[Indian Institute of Technology Madras]] (1989) and his M.S. and Ph.D. in Computer Science from [[Cornell University]] (1993). He conducted postdoctoral research at the [[Institute for Advanced Study]] (Princeton) and [[DIMACS]] at Rutgers, worked at the [[National University of Singapore]] and in industrial research at [[Bell Labs]], and joined the [[University of Maryland]] faculty in the early 2000s.<ref name="a">{{cite web |title=Dr. Aravind Srinivasan - Office of Alumni & Corporate Relations |url=https://acr.iitm.ac.in/latestdaas/dr-aravind-srinivasan/ |website=acr.iitm.ac.in |publisher=[[Indian Institute of Technology Madras]] |access-date=15 August 2025}}</ref>

==Research==
His research spans machine learning, [[randomized]] and [[probabilistic algorithms]],<ref>{{cite book |last1=Srinivasan |first1=A. |chapter=Distributions on level-sets with applications to approximation algorithms |title=Proceedings 42nd IEEE Symposium on Foundations of Computer Science |date=October 2001 |pages=588–597 |doi=10.1109/SFCS.2001.959935 |isbn=0-7695-1390-5 }}</ref> combinatorial and continuous optimization, and applications in [[computational epidemiology]],<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Babay |first1=Amy E. |last2=Dinitz |first2=Michael |last3=Srinivasan |first3=Aravind |last4=Tsepenekas |first4=Leonidas |last5=Vullikanti |first5=Anil |title=Controlling Epidemic Spread using Probabilistic Diffusion Models on Networks |journal=Proceedings of the 25th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics |date=3 May 2022 |pages=11641–11654 |url=https://proceedings.mlr.press/v151/babay22a.html |publisher=PMLR |language=en}}</ref> [[genomics]], [[Internet economy]], social networks, energy systems, and fairness in AI.<ref>{{cite news |title=🔍 How do we ensure fairness in AI-driven decisions? {{!}} Department of Computer Science, UMD posted on the topic {{!}} LinkedIn |url=https://www.linkedin.com/posts/department-of-computer-science-umd_umdcs-activity-7303123235494060032-rev7 |work=www.linkedin.com |agency=[[University of Maryland]] |date=15 March 2025 |language=en}}[[Wikipedia:SPS|{{sup|[''self-published'']}}]]</ref>

He has held editorial leadership roles, serving as [[Editor-in-chief|Editor‑in‑Chief]] of ''[[ACM Transactions on Algorithms]]'' (2014–2020),<ref>{{cite web |title=ACM Transactions on Algorithms Welcomes Aravind Srinivasan as New Editor-in-Chief {{!}} ACM MemberNet - August 28, 2014 |url=https://www.acm.org/articles/membernet/2014/membernet-08282014 |website=www.acm.org |publisher=[[Association for Computing Machinery]] |access-date=15 August 2025 |language=en}}</ref> Managing Editor/Editor of ''[[Theory of Computing]]'' (2006–2019),<ref>{{cite web |title=Editors: Theory of Computing: An Open Access Electronic Journal in Theoretical Computer Science |url=https://theoryofcomputing.org/editors.html |website=theoryofcomputing.org |access-date=15 August 2025}}</ref> Editor of ''Journal of Discrete Algorithms ([[Elsevier]])'' (2004–2012) and as an Editor for the ''Journal of the IISc''<ref>{{cite web |title=Editorial board {{!}} Journal of the Indian Institute of Science |url=https://link.springer.com/journal/41745/editorial-board |website=SpringerLink |publisher=[[Springer Nature]] |access-date=15 August 2025 |language=en}}</ref>
